accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (or `testID` mapped correctly in Expo). E.g., data-testid='run-button-4'.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text over backgrounds must meet WCAG AA standards. Use layered grays instead of pure black for components.
accessibility_and_testing.touch_targets: Minimum 56pt height/width for all scoring actions to ensure easy one-handed street cricket usage.
accessibility_and_testing.feedback: Ensure haptic feedback (Haptics API) or visual flash is applied to scoring button presses.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the app as a mobile-first Expo React Native app using NativeWind/Tailwind styling.
Implement the UI using Archetype 2 (The Performance Pro). Default to Dark mode (layered grays) with a sleek, athletic, high-contrast aesthetic.
Layout constraint for Live Scoring: Keep the score header fixed at the top, scrollable timeline/cards in the middle, and the scoring button pad anchored strictly to the bottom for thumb reach.
Do not use generic emoji for icons; strictly import and use @expo/vector-icons (Lucide or Ionicons).
Ensure 'data-testid' properties are applied consistently on all inputs, buttons, and navigable cards to satisfy testing criteria.

For typography, configure Google Fonts for 'Outfit' (Headings) and 'DM Sans' (Body). If Expo Google Fonts are not readily loadable, fall back to System Sans with appropriate weights, but attempt to load Outfit.
